CKV2_AWS_10.description: Ensure CloudTrail trails are integrated with CloudWatch Logs
CKV2_AWS_10.rationale: Real gap: enables metric filters and alarms on trail events. Deferred with the alerting module.

CKV2_AWS_40.description: Ensure AWS IAM policy does not allow full IAM privileges
CKV2_AWS_40.rationale: One of 8 IAM checks on one wildcard. All BLOCK, or 1 BLOCK + 7 WARN?

CKV2_AWS_5.description: Ensure that Security Groups are attached to another resource
CKV2_AWS_5.rationale: Test-environment artifact: no EC2 by design. Unattached SG has no attack surface.

CKV2_AWS_6.description: Ensure that S3 bucket has a Public Access block

CKV_AWS_109.description: Ensure IAM policies does not allow permissions management / resource exposure without constraints
CKV_AWS_109.rationale: Same generic-vs-resource-policy blind spot as CKV_AWS_111.

CKV_AWS_111.description: Ensure IAM policies does not allow write access without constraints
CKV_AWS_111.rationale: Generic IAM check on a KMS resource policy. CKV_AWS_33 (KMS-aware) passes the same statement.

CKV_AWS_115.description: Ensure that AWS Lambda function is configured for function-level concurrent execution limit
CKV_AWS_115.rationale: DoS and cost control. No exposure.

CKV_AWS_116.description: Ensure that AWS Lambda function is configured for a Dead Letter Queue (DLQ)
CKV_AWS_116.rationale: Reliability: a lost invocation is a missed remediation. Worth adding, not merge-blocking.

CKV_AWS_117.description: Ensure that AWS Lambda function is configured inside a VPC
CKV_AWS_117.rationale: Function calls only AWS APIs and touches no private resources. VPC placement would require a NAT gateway (~$32/mo) or several interface endpoints while removing nothing reachable.

CKV_AWS_144.description: Ensure that S3 bucket has cross-region replication enabled
CKV_AWS_144.rationale: Availability/DR control, not security. Real cost, no confidentiality benefit.

CKV_AWS_145.description: Ensure that S3 buckets are encrypted with KMS by default
CKV_AWS_145.rationale: CMK cost call — must match tfsec CMK rules.

CKV_AWS_173.description: Check encryption settings for Lambda environment variables
CKV_AWS_173.rationale: The only variable is ENFORCE=false. Not a secret.

CKV_AWS_18.description: Ensure the S3 bucket has access logging enabled
CKV_AWS_18.rationale: Same call as tfsec logging rule — must match.

CKV_AWS_189.description: Ensure EBS Volume is encrypted by KMS using a customer managed Key (CMK)
CKV_AWS_189.rationale: CMK cost call — must match tfsec CMK rules.

CKV_AWS_21.description: Ensure all data stored in the S3 bucket have versioning enabled

CKV_AWS_252.description: Ensure CloudTrail defines an SNS Topic
CKV_AWS_252.rationale: Notification, not prevention. Deferred with the alerting module.

CKV_AWS_272.description: Ensure AWS Lambda function is configured to validate code-signing
CKV_AWS_272.rationale: Supply-chain control; meaningful with multiple publishers, not for one function deployed from this repo.

CKV_AWS_338.description: Ensure CloudWatch log groups retains logs for at least 1 year
CKV_AWS_338.rationale: Real finding. 1-day retention is a deliberate cost decision for a portfolio account.

CKV_AWS_355.description: Ensure no IAM policies documents allow "*" as a statement's resource for restrictable actions
CKV_AWS_355.rationale: One of 8 IAM checks on one wildcard. All BLOCK, or 1 BLOCK + 7 WARN?

aws-ec2-no-public-egress-sgr.description: An egress security group rule allows traffic to /0.

aws-ec2-no-public-ingress-sgr.description: An ingress security group rule allows traffic from /0.

aws-ec2-volume-encryption-customer-key.description: EBS volume encryption should use Customer Managed Keys
